meta.description: Small concrete + structural foundation set: spread footings, grade beams, slab-on-grade. Hand-validated against the original estimator's quantity sheet.

S.text:
STRUCTURAL FOUNDATION PLAN — SHEET S-101

BUILDING FOOTPRINT: 60 ft x 80 ft (4,800 SF) slab-on-grade, 5" thick, 4000 PSI concrete with #4 @ 18" o.c. each way.

GRADE BEAMS: GB-1 around full perimeter and at column lines. Total length per plan = 320 LF, 12" wide x 24" deep.

REFER TO S-201 FOR SPREAD FOOTING SCHEDULE.
REFER TO S-301 FOR REINFORCING SCHEDULE.

NOTES:
1. All concrete shall be 4,000 PSI at 28 days.
2. Coordinate slab penetrations with M/E/P plans.
3. Compacted subgrade per geotech report.

SPREAD FOOTING SCHEDULE — SHEET S-201

MARK    SIZE         REINF      QTY
F-1     4'-0" x 4'-0" x 12"   (5) #5 EW BOT       8 EA
F-2     5'-0" x 5'-0" x 14"   (6) #5 EW BOT       4 EA

TOTAL SPREAD FOOTINGS: 12 EA

Located at column lines per S-101. See S-301 for typical rebar details.

REINFORCING SCHEDULE — SHEET S-301

GRADE BEAM GB-1: (4) #5 TOP, (4) #5 BOT, #4 ties @ 12" o.c.
  - Length: 320 LF (per S-101)
  - Longitudinal #5 = 8 bars * 320 LF = 2,560 LF

FOOTINGS F-1/F-2: (5)-(6) #5 EW BOT — see S-201.
  - F-1: 8 ftgs * 10 bars * 4 LF = 320 LF
  - F-2: 4 ftgs * 12 bars * 5 LF = 240 LF

SLAB ON GRADE: #4 @ 18" o.c. each way (not #5).

WALL DOWELS to grade beams: #5 @ 16" o.c., 3'-0" embed = ~3,280 LF.

TOTAL #5 REINFORCING: approximately 6,400 LF.

C.text:
CIVIL SITE PLAN — SHEET C-101

BUILDING FOOTPRINT: 60' x 80' = 4,800 SF (matches structural S-101).

FOUNDATION WALL (perimeter retaining wall, 8" CMU on 12" concrete footing):
  - North face: 80 LF
  - South face: 80 LF
  - East face: 60 LF
  - West face: 60 LF
  - TOTAL: 280 LF of foundation wall

This wall encloses the crawl space along the building perimeter.
Reference S-101 for slab and grade beam scope (do not duplicate).
